nodes.name: advanced-event-handler-refs.md
nodes.summary: React best-practice rule recommending storing event handler callbacks in refs so effects don't re-subscribe when the handler prop changes, including a useEffectEvent-based alternative.

nodes.name: advanced-init-once.md
nodes.summary: Best-practice rule for ensuring app-wide initialization logic (e.g. SDK setup) runs exactly once rather than being re-triggered on every component mount via useEffect.

nodes.name: advanced-use-latest.md
nodes.summary: Documents using React's useEffectEvent hook to create stable callback references that always call the latest handler without re-running effects.
nodes.languageNotes: useEffectEvent is a newer React API for extracting non-reactive logic from effects without adding it to the dependency array.

nodes.name: async-api-routes.md
nodes.summary: Critical-impact rule warning against sequential await waterfalls in API routes and server actions, recommending parallelizing independent async calls.

nodes.name: async-defer-await.md
nodes.summary: Explains deferring await calls until their result is actually needed instead of awaiting eagerly, avoiding unnecessary blocking.

nodes.name: async-dependencies.md
nodes.summary: Describes structuring async operations by their actual data dependencies so independent calls run in parallel instead of serially.

nodes.name: async-parallel.md
nodes.summary: Critical-impact rule recommending Promise.all() to run independent async operations concurrently instead of sequentially awaiting each one.

nodes.name: async-suspense-boundaries.md
nodes.summary: Guidance on placing React Suspense boundaries strategically to enable streaming and avoid layout shift while data loads.

nodes.name: bundle-barrel-imports.md
nodes.summary: Critical-impact rule warning that importing from barrel (index) files defeats tree-shaking and bloats bundle size, recommending direct module imports instead.

nodes.name: bundle-conditional.md
nodes.summary: Recommends conditionally loading modules only when needed rather than including them in the main bundle unconditionally.

nodes.name: bundle-defer-third-party.md
nodes.summary: Advises deferring the loading of non-critical third-party scripts, such as analytics, until after the main content has rendered.

nodes.name: bundle-dynamic-imports.md
nodes.summary: Critical-impact rule recommending dynamic import() or next/dynamic for heavy components to enable code-splitting and reduce initial bundle size.

nodes.name: bundle-preload.md
nodes.summary: Describes preloading resources based on anticipated user intent, such as on hover, to reduce perceived latency for likely next navigations.

nodes.name: client-event-listeners.md
nodes.summary: Recommends deduplicating global event listener subscriptions, similar to SWR-style patterns, to avoid redundant window/document listeners across components.

nodes.name: client-localstorage-schema.md
nodes.summary: Guidance on versioning localStorage schemas and minimizing stored data to avoid stale or bloated client-side state.

nodes.name: client-passive-event-listeners.md
nodes.summary: Recommends marking scroll, touch, and wheel event listeners as passive to improve scrolling performance by avoiding main-thread blocking.

nodes.name: client-swr-dedup.md
nodes.summary: Documents using SWR for automatic request deduplication and caching of client-side data fetches.

nodes.name: js-batch-dom-css.md
nodes.summary: Explains avoiding layout thrashing by batching DOM reads and writes together instead of interleaving them, which forces repeated synchronous reflows.

nodes.name: js-cache-function-results.md
nodes.summary: Recommends caching or memoizing the results of repeated function calls with identical inputs to avoid redundant computation.

nodes.name: js-cache-property-access.md
nodes.summary: Advises caching repeated property accesses inside loops into a local variable to avoid redundant lookups on each iteration.
